summary: Ocean Capital Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K announcing the consummation of its initial public offering on June 10, 2026. The IPO comprised 11,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment, generating $115 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one ordinary share, one right, and one redeemable warrant. Simultaneously, a private placement of 150,000 units raised $1.5 million. Net proceeds were placed in a trust account. This is a standard blank-check company IPO closing and not a special situation.
